title: Adhesive Force
definition: Adhesive force refers to the intermolecular attraction between unlike molecules, causing them to cling to one another. It is fundamental to surface chemistry, fluid mechanics, and material science.
importanceInUpsc: Tested frequently in UPSC Prelims (GS-1 Science & Tech / Physics) through daily life phenomena, capillary action, meniscus formation, and biomedical/industrial applications.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Adhesive Force.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
